_doc: What the narrator says (live/voice.log, read aloud by tools/narrator.ps1 while live/voice_on exists; F9 toggles). Edit live: read on every brain call. events: which kinds of lines are spoken. repeat_turns: the same line isn't spoken again within this many game turns. repeat_turns_by_event overrides repeat_turns per event (0 = always speak).

speech._doc: engine onecore (smoother; voices: Mark, David, Zira, George, Hazel, Susan) or sapi (old desktop voices: David, Zira, Hazel). rate: 1.0 normal, up to 3.0. Read for every line.
